### IN01 — an instruction says "this", "that", or "it" and two targets are possible

- **Rule**: Take the target from what was shown or edited most recently, state that reading in the first line of the reply, and go on. When the action cannot be undone, name both readings and stop.
- **Decider**: agent (the action can be undone) / owner (the action cannot be undone)
- **Strength**: C
- **Derived from**: a wrong reading that is stated up front and can be undone costs one correction; a question costs a round trip every time.
